title: Thamanya
description: Visual identity and campaign concept for an Arabic story series on Andalusia: posters, vinyl and disc artwork, and interface mockups.
role: Concept, research, visual identity design, and execution of all deliverables.

caseStudy.title: Thamanya — A Visual Identity Across the Eras
caseStudy.idea: Thamanya is an Arabic audio-content platform. The concept: what if its story series "The Fall of Andalusia" had been sold in every era of audio, from the gramophone to YouTube and streaming platforms, as the product people bought to listen?
caseStudy.research: A study of Andalusian history and architecture, merged with the poster and cover styles distinctive to each era and its listening medium.
caseStudy.execution: A poster or cover for each era reflecting its medium (gramophone, vinyl, through to digital interfaces), plus the project's full visual identity.
caseStudy.tools: Research and review in Gemini, image generation in ChatGPT Image, final edits in Canva and Hypic.

title: Egycloz

caseStudy.title: Egycloz — A Campaign for a Local Brand

title: Athath
description: Brand concept visuals for a furniture company, built around floating sculpted pieces.
role: Concept, art direction, and execution of all deliverables.

caseStudy.title: Athath — A Furniture Brand Above the Clouds
caseStudy.idea: An experimental, self-initiated concept project: a furniture brand built around one visual thought, sculpted furniture pieces floating in the sky above Cairo, the home reimagined as a dream under the promise "More than a home, a brighter tomorrow." A deliberate departure in style from most previous work.
caseStudy.execution: A set of brand visuals: wide hero scenes where the pieces float over the Cairo skyline and the pyramids, a flying-carpet moment for the local touch, and clean product shots of the individual floating pieces, all carrying the bilingual identity, name, and tagline.
caseStudy.tools: Image and design generation in ChatGPT Image, fixes and retouching in Photopia (the browser-based Photoshop alternative), color correction in Hypic.

title: Method Men
description: Product and lifestyle visuals for a men's body wash range.
role: Concept, shoot direction, and execution of all deliverables.

caseStudy.title: Method Men — Body Wash in Its Element
caseStudy.idea: A collaboration with a friend who was learning how to build a social media campaign for skincare products: an unofficial spec campaign built around a real product, Method Men body wash, placing the three-scent range in its natural element — warm, sunlit, wet bathroom scenes that make the product part of a daily ritual.
caseStudy.execution: Seven visuals: an annotated campaign sheet introducing the three scents (Glacier + Granite, Sandalwood + Vetiver, Juniper + Sage), then product and lifestyle shots across shower water, steam and bubbles, stone shelving, and a quiet everyday bath moment.
caseStudy.tools: Moodboard and visual referencing on Pinterest and Behance, image generation in ChatGPT Image, final edits in Canva and Hypic.

title: Rox Adams 26
description: Concept design for an SUV: exterior design board, interior product sheet, environments, and a launch film.
role: Concept, storyboard writing, AI ad direction, and execution of all deliverables.

caseStudy.title: Rox Adams 26 — An SUV Designed From Scratch
caseStudy.idea: An experiment to explore the limits of storyboard writing and AI ad direction. A car ad was the choice because car advertising lives on detail: a complete SUV concept designed from a blank page, from the exterior to the cabin and materials, then launched with a short film in a surreal desert of glass monoliths.
caseStudy.execution: The ad was written first as a storyboard, then built shot by shot: an exterior design board (four angles plus detail studies), an interior product sheet mapping every control, screen and finish as the AI-generation reference for a consistent cabin, environment scenes, and a 9:16 launch film of the SUV moving through the mirrored desert.
caseStudy.tools: References and sheets prepared in ChatGPT, video generated on Google's Omni Flash 2.1 model via Flow, editing in Adobe Premiere, color grading in CapCut Desktop, and music generated in Suno to his own composition.

title: Podcast
description: Full-length AI video for a podcast project.
role: Idea writing, storyboard, and video direction.

caseStudy.title: Dialogue That Moves — A Podcast Promo Made With AI
caseStudy.idea: A gift for a friend, a young journalist: a full AI promo film for a podcast episode that places her in the studio she deserves — from a designed title poster to ink-on-paper calligraphy to the interview scene.
caseStudy.execution: Idea and storyboard written from scratch, then a 27-second vertical film: an opening title poster introducing the host and guest, a calligraphy sequence written on camera, and a closing studio conversation.
caseStudy.tools: Character sheet generated in ChatGPT, video and voice-over generated on Google's Omni Flash 2.1 model via Flow, editing on Adobe Premiere, and color grading on CapCut Desktop.

title: Nadek
role: Idea, writing, storyboard, and video direction.

caseStudy.title: Nadek — A Juice Ad Built on Minimal Means
caseStudy.idea: A different kind of experiment: exploring filmmaking and advertising with the fewest possible resources, and how far visual direction can go in presenting ideas for juice and food-and-beverage products. A juice ad for Nadec, from the store shelf to the rooftop table.
caseStudy.execution: The ad was written and storyboarded from scratch; character, location and product sheets were designed as generation references, then built as a 17-second vertical film: a man picking up the juice at the store, hero product shots on ice, and a closing rooftop gathering where everyone drinks Nadec.
caseStudy.tools: Character, location and product sheets designed in ChatGPT Image, video and sound generated on Google's Omni Flash 2.1 model via Flow, editing in Adobe Premiere, and color grading on CapCut Desktop.

title: Spiro Spathis
role: Idea, writing, storyboard, and video direction.

caseStudy.title: Spiro Spathis — A Nostalgic Soda Film
caseStudy.idea: An exploration of artistic capability in visual direction and in presenting ideas for food-and-beverage products: a short cinematic ad for Spiro Spathis built around the brand's iconic green bottle and a warm, nostalgic mood.
caseStudy.execution: The film was written and storyboarded from scratch; character, location and product sheets were designed as generation references, then built as a 17-second cinematic film: the bottle on a vintage living-room table, a hand opening the cap, a first sip, and a closing hero shot of the bottle with the character behind it.
caseStudy.tools: Character, location and product sheets designed in ChatGPT Image, video and audio generated on Google's Omni Flash 2.1 model via Flow, editing in Adobe Premiere, and color grading on CapCut Desktop.
